page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data.

Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance does not include any graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without massive memory footprints. Suitable workloads include web serving, batch processing, CI/CD pipelines, and front-end application servers.
